_comment: Question bank shared by all plants. Order matters only as a tie-breaker when the engine picks the next question. 'yes_no' expands to Yes / No options. Every question also gets a 'Not sure' button in the UI.

questions.text: How many leaves are yellow?
questions.text_ur: Kitni pattiyan peeli ho rahi hain?

options.label: Only 1-2 old leaves, once in a while
Several leaves, and more keep turning yellow

questions.text: What does the yellowing look like?
questions.text_ur: Peela-pan kaisa dikhta hai?

options.label: Whole plant looks pale / washed out
Yellow between the veins, veins stay green
Yellow rings around brown or dark spots

questions.text: What is the problem with the flowers?
questions.text_ur: Phoolon ke sath kya masla hai?

options.label: Flowers turn brown and dry quickly

questions.text: Look closely under the leaves, along the stems and on the soil. What do you see?
questions.text_ur: Pattiyon ke neeche, tano par aur mitti par ghaur se dekhein. Kya nazar aata hai?

options.label: Fine webbing or tiny moving dots
Brown / tan bumps that scrape off with a nail
Tiny black flies around the soil
Slender tiny insects or silvery streaks
Clusters of soft green or black insects on new growth
Tiny white insects that fly up when touched

questions.text: What do the spots or patches look like?
questions.text_ur: Dhabbe ya nishaan kaise dikhte hain?

options.label: Dry brown / tan spots with a darker edge or rings
Reddish-brown spots with a lighter centre
Many tiny pale or yellow dots (speckling)
Pale, white or tan dry patches on the side facing the sun
Small raised corky bumps, mostly under the leaves
Black sooty film that wipes off

questions.text: How does the browning look?
questions.text_ur: Bhoora-pan (brown hona) kaisa hai?

options.label: Only the leaf tips are brown and dry
Leaf edges are brown, often with a yellow band
Dry brown patches in the middle of leaves

questions.text: How is the plant growing?
questions.text_ur: Podha kaise barh raha hai?

options.label: Long bare stems, small far-apart leaves, leaning to the light
New leaves come out small and pale
Looks healthy but almost no new growth

questions.text: How are the leaves falling or bending?
questions.text_ur: Pattiyan kaise gir ya jhuk rahi hain?

options.label: Bending or creasing in the middle, base is firm

questions.text: How old / big is the plant?
questions.text_ur: Podha kitna purana / bara hai?

questions.text: Do you see white cottony threads with tiny tan 'mustard seed' balls at the soil line?
questions.text_ur: Kya mitti ki satah par safed resha (dhaage) aur rai jaise chhote bhoore daane nazar aate hain?

questions.text: Are the leaves sticky, or covered with a black sooty film?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyan chipchipi hain ya un par kaali kaalikh jaisi teh hai?

questions.text: Are there swollen, warty or deformed growths on the leaves or flower stalk?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyon ya phool ki dandi par phooli hui, khurdari ya bigri hui growth hai?

questions.text: Push a finger 2-3 cm into the soil. How does it feel?
questions.text_ur: Ungli 2-3 cm mitti mein daal kar dekhein. Mitti kaisi hai?

questions.text: Does the soil or the base of the plant smell sour or rotten?
questions.text_ur: Kya mitti ya podey ki jarh se sadi hui / khatti boo aati hai?

questions.text: Does the pot have a drainage hole, and does water drain out freely?
questions.text_ur: Kya gamle mein drainage hole hai aur paani aasani se nikal jata hai?

questions.text: Does the soil dry out within 1-2 days after a full watering?
questions.text_ur: Kya poora paani dene ke 1-2 din mein hi mitti sookh jati hai?

questions.text: Which leaves are affected most?
questions.text_ur: Kaun si pattiyan zyada mutasir hain?

questions.text: Are the spots spreading quickly (new ones within a few days)?
questions.text_ur: Kya dhabbe tezi se phail rahe hain (kuch dinon mein naye dhabbe)?

questions.text: Is there a white or yellow crust on the soil surface or the pot rim?
questions.text_ur: Kya mitti ki satah ya gamle ke kinare par safed / peeli teh (crust) jami hai?

questions.text: Has the plant been near cold (below about 10 C), a cold window, or a cold draft?
questions.text_ur: Kya podha thand (10 C se kam), thandi khirki ya thandi hawa ke qareeb raha hai?

questions.text: What light does the plant get?
questions.text_ur: Podey ko kitni roshni milti hai?

options.label: Bright light, but no direct sun
Dim spot, far from a window

questions.text: How do you fertilize the plant?
questions.text_ur: Aap podey ko khaad (fertilizer) kaise dete hain?

options.label: Often, or a strong dose recently

questions.text: What water do you mostly use?
questions.text_ur: Aap aksar kaun sa paani istemal karte hain?

questions.text: Is the plant near an AC or heater, or in a very dry room?
questions.text_ur: Kya podha AC ya heater ke qareeb hai, ya kamre ki hawa bohat khushk hai?

questions.text: Was the plant moved, repotted or bought in the last 3-4 weeks?
questions.text_ur: Kya pichle 3-4 hafton mein podha jagah badla, repot hua ya khareeda gaya?

questions.text: Is the plant in a very hot spot (above about 35 C, hot wall or window glass)?
questions.text_ur: Kya podha bohat garam jagah par hai (35 C se zyada, garam deewar ya sheesha)?

questions.text: Is it currently winter / the cold season?
questions.text_ur: Kya abhi sardi ka mausam hai?

questions.text: When was the plant last repotted?
questions.text_ur: Podha aakhri baar kab repot hua tha?

options.label: More than 2 years ago, or never

questions.text: Is the plant under room lights for most of the night?
questions.text_ur: Kya podha raat ke zyada hissay mein kamre ki roshni mein rehta hai?

questions.text: Gently slide the plant out of its pot. How do the roots look?
questions.text_ur: Podey ko aahista gamle se nikaal kar jarein dekhein. Jarein kaisi hain?

options.label: Brown or black, mushy, falling apart
Firm, but packed tightly and circling the pot
White or light, firm, with space left

questions.text: Does the soil stay wet for many days after watering?
questions.text_ur: Kya paani dene ke baad mitti kai din tak geeli rehti hai?

questions.text: When you water, does water sit on top or take a long time to drain?
questions.text_ur: Paani dene par kya paani upar khara rehta hai ya der se nikalta hai?

questions.text: Does the soil often stay completely dry for several days before you water?
questions.text_ur: Kya mitti aksar kai din tak bilkul sookhi rehti hai, phir paani milta hai?

questions.text: Is the plant leaning or stretching toward the window?
questions.text_ur: Kya podha khirki ki taraf jhuk ya lamba ho raha hai?

questions.text: Is the damage mostly on the leaves facing the sun or window?
questions.text_ur: Kya nuqsan zyada tar dhoop / khirki ki taraf wali pattiyon par hai?

questions.text: Are the leaves still firm and plump?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyan ab bhi sakht aur bhari hui (moti) hain?

questions.text: Does the plant droop in the afternoon heat and look better in the evening?
questions.text_ur: Kya podha dopehar ki garmi mein jhukta hai aur shaam ko behtar ho jata hai?

questions.text: Do the leaves often stay wet (misting, watering over the leaves, very humid air)?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyan aksar geeli rehti hain (spray, upar se paani, bohat nami)?

questions.text: Do the bumps come off when you scrape them gently with a fingernail?
questions.text_ur: Kya nakhun se aahista khurachne par yeh daane utar jate hain?

questions.text: Has the plant been bumped, moved around, or touched by pets or people recently?
questions.text_ur: Kya podey ko haal hi mein takkar lagi, hilaya gaya, ya pets / logon ne chhua?

questions.text: Tap a leaf over white paper. Do tiny dots fall and move around?
questions.text_ur: Patti ko safed kaghaz ke upar jhaarein. Kya chhote chhote nuqte gir kar chalte hain?

questions.text: When you press a white clump, does it smear (it is a soft insect)?
questions.text_ur: Safed gucchay ko dabane par kya woh pis kar phail jata hai (narm keera)?

questions.text: Are there silvery streaks with tiny black dots on the leaves?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyon par chandi jaisi lakeerein aur chhote kaale nuqte hain?

questions.text: Apart from this, does the plant look healthy, with green, firm new leaves?
questions.text_ur: Iske ilawa kya podha sehatmand hai, aur nayi pattiyan hari aur mazboot hain?

questions.text: Did the damage appear within a few days after the cold?
questions.text_ur: Kya yeh nuqsan thand lagne ke kuch dinon ke andar zahir hua?

questions.text: Are leaves rotting and collapsing right at the soil line?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyan bilkul mitti ki satah par sad kar gir rahi hain?

questions.text: When you press the affected part, is it soft, mushy and watery?
questions.text_ur: Mutasir hissay ko dabane par kya woh narm, gila aur paani jaisa hai?

questions.text: Has the flower been open for more than 3-4 weeks?
questions.text_ur: Kya phool 3-4 hafte se zyada purana hai?

questions.text: How often do you water this plant?
questions.text_ur: Aap is podey ko kitni baar paani dete hain?

questions.text: When you water, how much do you give?
questions.text_ur: Paani dete waqt kitna dete hain?

options.label: Until water drains out of the bottom
A lot, and the saucer fills up

questions.text: How do the affected leaves feel?
questions.text_ur: Mutasir pattiyan chhoone par kaisi hain?

questions.text: Is the base of the stem (the crown) firm when you gently press it?
questions.text_ur: Kya tane ka nichla hissa dabane par sakht hai?

questions.text: How is the newest growth?
questions.text_ur: Sab se nayi growth kaisi hai?

options.label: No new growth for a long time

questions.text: Can you see roots coming out of the drainage hole or above the soil?
questions.text_ur: Kya jarein drainage hole se ya mitti ke upar nazar aa rahi hain?

questions.text: How warm is the room where the plant lives?
questions.text_ur: Podha jis kamre mein hai woh kitna garam hai?

questions.text: Do other plants nearby show the same problem or insects?
questions.text_ur: Kya qareeb ke doosre podon mein bhi yehi masla ya keeray hain?

questions.text: Do you see ants walking on the plant?
questions.text_ur: Kya podey par cheentiyan nazar aati hain?

questions.text: How fast is the problem getting worse?
questions.text_ur: Yeh masla kitni tezi se barh raha hai?

questions.text: How many hours of direct sun does the plant get?
questions.text_ur: Podey ko roz kitne ghantay seedhi dhoop milti hai?

questions.text: Is the air around the plant still (closed room, no fan or breeze)?
questions.text_ur: Kya podey ke aas paas hawa ruki hui hai (band kamra, pankha nahi)?

questions.text: Are leaves dropping off the plant?
questions.text_ur: Kya pattiyan podey se gir rahi hain?
